# Past Papers · Scholium

> Assemble custom topical IGCSE past-paper practice sets by subject, component, and
> chapter, with mark schemes, for exam revision. Covers IGCSE Economics (0455), Computer
> Science (0478), Additional Mathematics (0606), International Mathematics (0607),
> Biology (0610), Chemistry (0620), and Physics (0625).

- [Past Papers tool](https://pastpapers.thescholium.com/): pick a subject, component, and
  chapters to generate a custom topical practice paper with its mark scheme.
- [Terms of Service](https://pastpapers.thescholium.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://pastpapers.thescholium.com/privacy)
